You’ve got a few options if things aren’t working out:

Rental doesn’t fit or is misrepresented: Refunds depend on the lender’s policy; approved fit refunds are app credit only, not cash. If misrepresented, report the issue and request a refund in‑app.
Resales: All sales are final, no refunds.
Earnings: You can keep using your balance in‑app or withdraw to your bank (min £30, via Stripe).
Off‑app payments: Not protected at all—any side deals are fully at your own risk.
Tax & reporting: If you don’t provide required HMRC info, your account and payouts may be paused.
Lending tiers: If your performance drops, your lender tier can be downgraded, but you can regain it in a later quarter.
Leaving the platform: You can delete your account by emailing us from your registered email address.

How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

ByRo Bot · AI

ByRo Bot · AI says:

To get the best results on By Rotation, you’ll want to treat your profile and listings like a shop window.

Optimize your profile: Add a clear profile photo or brand logo and a friendly, detailed bio about you and your lending goals to build trust.
Create strong listings: When listing an item, carefully categorise it, fully describe the fit and any minor defects, and share styling tips. Always use high‑quality, original photos of the item on a real person, with multiple angles and close‑ups of details and labels. Avoid stock images, flat‑lays, mannequins, or wrinkled clothing.
Set clear rental terms: Choose sensible pricing, availability, and any discounts so renters feel your listing is fair and flexible.
Consider Listing Boost: If you want extra visibility, use a 7‑ or 14‑day Listing Boost so your item appears higher in search and browse feeds with a ‘Boosted’ badge. It improves exposure, but doesn’t guarantee rentals.
Track performance: While boosted, keep an eye on views and saves in your listing insights, and review the end‑of‑boost email to see what worked.
Protect yourself with proof of condition: As a lender or renter, always record clear, timestamped videos of the item when sending/receiving and before return, plus photos of any damage. This is required evidence if a damage dispute arises.
Use earnings and credits smartly: You can pay for rentals with your Wallet earnings or with credits that apply automatically at checkout. Remember credits are separate from Wallet balance and can’t be refunded by other methods.
Get fully set up: Make sure you’ve fully completed sign‑up, including ID verification, and filled out your profile so others feel confident renting from or to you.

Putting care into your profile, listings, photos, pricing, and documentation is the best way to get strong, consistent results on the app.

We can’t see your exact booking total from here, but here’s how it works on our side:

Total charge: The amount you approved at checkout is held when you request the rental and only fully charged once the lender accepts.
When money moves to the lender: After the rental is marked Complete, the lender’s payout appears in their balance and can be withdrawn (bank transfers typically take 3 working days, and Stripe processing for payments/refunds can take 8–10 working days).
If a rental is declined/expired/cancelled: Any held funds are released or refunded; this can take up to 8 working days to show on your statement, depending on your bank.

If you’re asking when your money will arrive to your bank or card, it’ll usually be within 3–10 working days after the relevant action (completion, refund, or withdrawal), depending on whether it’s a payout or a card refund.
